result.summary: Several visual/layout issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a broken discount badge showing “-0%”, and an incomplete horizontal list that cuts off content.

issues.description: Discount badge on the pizza card displays “-0%”, which looks broken or like missing/erroneous data.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when there is no discount, or show a valid percentage (e.g. “-20%”) from real promo data.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated with no full name visible on the card.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards/text can show the full name (e.g. ellipsis only after a readable portion plus tooltip).

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible), so users may not know more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/peek of next chip, padding, or a clear scroll affordance so the row doesn’t look clipped.

issues.description: “Fastest near you” row clips the third card at the screen edge with no clear indication of more content.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding/peek and ensure horizontal scroll is obvious.

issues.description: Bottom card (pizza) is heavily cropped by the tab bar, so the offer looks incomplete on first view.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so cards aren’t obscured by the navigation bar.
